args.body: Take MAINTAINER-FUNDED-DOCS-DELIVERY under a valid lease after checking prior work. Count the queued Algora board retrieval against the three-GET allowance and check its receipt before using it. Follow an original issue only when the board gives a concrete reason to expect an open funded task that fits. On a qualifying task, run the acceptance check immediately and retain the result even if submission or payout remains unresolved. Verify the original issue and current bounty state before treating a displayed amount as a live offer.

description: Treasury shows CAD 0 available and CAD 0 verified revenue. Five feedback sources remain unclassified, so buyer demand is unknown. The SQLite marketplace route still depends on seller activation and a concrete paid benefit beyond the free download. Test a separate route where a maintainer has already attached payment to a specific documentation or data-quality deliverable. An original open bounty with a testable acceptance criterion can support immediate offline work. Submission eligibility, payment compatibility and settlement each require separate evidence.
